roadMarkingsEvidence: Implemented a continuous longitudinal separator and a dashed delimiter toward the northern parking edge, plus four marked crossings at Ismail. Their positions, widths and dash lengths are visual estimates from the available Street View and overhead imagery. Junction and zebra approaches are excluded from the longitudinal strokes. A double-line segment is visible in intersection imagery, but its exact endpoints and length were not established; that transition is not represented as a measured or exact double line.

treeEvidence: Individual approximate trunk/crown positions from official 2020/2026 overhead imagery, corrected by current Street View. The tree beside the south shelter is placed east and toward the curb, as observed. The two heavily pruned enclosure trunks have approximate positions and heights; no complete mature crowns are inferred. All metric tree dimensions and species remain estimates; no regular planting grid.
poleEvidence: Mapped OSM street_lamp positions plus a close pair near1354/1356 observed by the project lead in September2025 Street View; latter coordinates and all pole forms/heights are estimates.

treeIndividualEvidence.evidence: Street View September 2025, EastUrl heading270: mature tree is outside the shelter, immediately east of it and toward the carriageway. Moved from preliminary1358/477 after this observation. Relative location confirmed; exact coordinates, dimensions and species estimated.

crossingEvidence: All four zebra crossings confirmed in current Street View by the project lead. Three centres follow mapped OSM crossings; the eastern centre is estimated between mapped lowered curbs. No central islands are visible.
axisEvidence: New public ground starts atx1240 because the previous public road/sidewalk ends there; only BUC03 southern court reachesx1241. The previously missing1m public strip is filled without changing BUC03. All exact prior coverage is subtracted. Ismail uses current OSM road/crossing/kerb alignment verified against both official overhead images, separately from the official Strazi_RM axis offset. Road widths and court finishes remain estimates; all complete prior bodies and the additional mapped sports body retain ownership.

preservedNativeEvidence: The open tennis-ground enclosure previously retained as a native sports volume is now corrected explicitly in correctedNativeSportsOutline. No authored cadastral building is added.
evidence: Official complete cladiri footprints only; no parcel/address volumes and no official height/storey values. All elevations, roof forms, material shades, pedestrian widths, tree dimensions and minor object positions are estimates. No photographed vehicles are modeled.2026 is a source layer name, not an exact acquisition date. Rear elevations hidden by foliage remain unconfirmed.

correctedNativeSportsOutline.evidence: Two open tennis courts are visible in both official orthophotos2020/2026 and Google Satellite directly inspected by the project lead on2026-10-23; the exact satellite capture date is unknown and copyright2026 is not its acquisition date. The enclosing OSM way is tagged building=yes/club=sport, but these three overhead views contradict an enclosed roofed volume. Withdraw only that native volume after the new sporting ground and previous BUC03 cells are ready. Preserve both pitch IDs and all complete official building bodies.
correctedNativeSportsOutline.markingEvidence: Court outer outlines and orientations follow the two exact current OSM pitch polygons. Interior singles, service and centre lines use estimated proportions from the official ITF court diagram, scaled inside each mapped quadrilateral. This does not establish that local line positions were measured. Paint width and colour are approximate. Lines on newly authored ground are exclusive surface patches; lines over retained BUC03 ground are narrow non-colliding decals only. No net, new fence, roof or cadastral ID is inferred.
